s: Stuttgart (the capital and largest city of Baden-Württemberg, Germany)
Stuttgart.et: From Old High German stuotgarten (“stud farm”), from stuot (stud) + garten (garden). The city was founded in 950 CE by Duke Liudolf of Swabia to breed warhorses.

Stütze.et: From Middle High German stütze, ultimately from the root of stützen (“to support”).

s: mare (of other equids) or female of other animals (especially in compounds).
Stute.et: From Middle High German stuot, from Old High German stuot (“herd of horses”), from Proto-Germanic *stōdą.
